---
title: "JMS: Bald God of Diplomatic Sci-Fi"
author: "Jon Minton"
date: "2026-08-22"
categories: [television, sci-fi, stories, diplomacy, myth]
draft: true

---

As discussed [previously](../../guano-guild-origin/index.qmd), one of [my father](../../book-of-nigel/index.qmd)'s favourite TV shows in the 2000s was Carnivàle, a Gothic high fantasy nominally about a circus troupe, but really about a high-stakes Manichean conflict between a sartorially elegant Dark Priest and a scruffy and reluctant Healer. I say *one of*, because I can't verify this was his favourite show of this decade, even though, being cancelled after just two seasons which promised but never quite revealed the show's deep lore and cosmic mythos, it was almost certainly his most missed show. 

When it comes to the 1990s, there's much less doubt as to his favourite TV series. 

It was Babylon 5, a sci-fi show, created by J Michael Straczynski, set on a cylindrical spinning space station which functions as something like a cross between a model UN and a cosmopolitan city. 

In the title I described the show as 'Diplomatic Sci-Fi', as surfacing and resolving conflict between alien factions through skilled negotiation and compromise forms much of the narrative backbone of the show.

```{dot}
//| label: fig-dyad-structure
//| fig-cap: "The ambassador-aide structure of Babylon 5's four peer factions, as established in the early seasons. Horizontal ties among the principals carry the diplomacy; the vertical tie within each faction carries counsel and conscience. The human hosts substitute a command triad for the ambassador-aide dyad."
graph b5_dyads {
  graph [newrank=true, splines=true, nodesep=0.45, ranksep=1.1,
         fontname="Helvetica", bgcolor="transparent"]
  node [shape=box, style="rounded,filled", fillcolor="white",

  edge [color="gray45"]

  subgraph cluster_humans {
    label="Earth Alliance (hosts)"
    fontsize=12
    style="rounded,dashed"
    color="#2a78d6"
    bgcolor="#eaf2fc"
    sheridan  [label="Sinclair / Sheridan\nCommander"]
    ivanova   [label="Ivanova\nFirst Officer"]
    garibaldi [label="Garibaldi\nSecurity Chief"]
    sheridan -- ivanova
    sheridan -- garibaldi

  subgraph cluster_minbari {

    style="rounded"
    color="#eda100"

    delenn  [label="Delenn\nAmbassador"]
    lennier [label="Lennier\nAide"]
    delenn -- lennier
  }

  subgraph cluster_centauri {
    label="Centauri Republic"
    fontsize=12
    style="rounded"
    color="#eb6834"
    bgcolor="#fdece5"
    londo [label="Londo Mollari\nAmbassador"]
    vir   [label="Vir Cotto\nAide"]
    londo -- vir
  }

  subgraph cluster_narn {
    label="Narn Regime"
    fontsize=12
    style="rounded"
    color="#1baf7a"
    bgcolor="#e4f6ee"
    gkar   [label="G'Kar\nAmbassador"]
    natoth [label="Na'Toth\nAide"]
    gkar -- natoth
  }

  { rank=same; sheridan; delenn; londo; gkar }
  { rank=same; ivanova; garibaldi; lennier; vir; natoth }

  // diplomacy among the principals
  edge [color="gray25", penwidth=1.2, constraint=false]
  sheridan -- delenn
  delenn -- londo
  londo -- gkar
  sheridan -- londo
  delenn -- gkar
  sheridan -- gkar
}
```
